title: Part 2: ambiguity gradient — 4 topics from well-known to debatable

notes: Same 4-liar setup across 4 topics with different ambiguity.
MMR (very certain) → Climate (high) → LK-99 (medium-high) → Ego depletion (medium).
Tests whether contagion scales with how uncertain the model is about the topic.
Ego depletion already shows 3/5 contagion, MMR shows 0/5.
